verdict.summary: The new validateStore binding directly validates the receiver's Graph with the existing SHACL engine while parsing only the supplied shapes graph. The implementation preserves the opt-in feature boundary, exposes the intended wasm camelCase name, and documents the default-graph-only dataset semantics. The native tests exercise violating and conforming stored data, equivalence with the stateless path modulo blank-node renaming, repeatability, default-versus-named graph behavior, and stateless-path independence; wasm tests cover the actual exported path and parse-error behavior. The public-surface documentation is updated consistently. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue was found. Tests could not be executed in this checkout because cargo is unavailable, so this verdict is based on the supplied diff and read-only source context.
